honesty_boundary: All 2018-2023 history is consumed development research; post-2023 outcomes and CY-011 remain unread and no result is independent confirmation.

track_a.low_skewness: negative 60-session skewness of accepted causal daily log returns
track_a.low_idio: negative 20-session standard deviation of stock causal return minus each date's cross-sectional median causal return

redundancy.residual_rank_diagnostic: same-date OLS residual of low-skew percentile rank on low-idio percentile rank
redundancy.incremental_required: residual top-20 net excess positive full and in both blocks

track_b.baseline_reason: CHINEXT V1 is the repository's canonical existing candidate lifecycle; the frozen stock-specific breakdown state is known before its next-open admission and can filter new candidates without selecting a weak preserved mixed strategy or changing ranking, exits, or holdings.
track_b.condition: event-date causal-coordinate close strictly below the minimum causal-coordinate low of the previous 20 completed sessions
track_b.domain: candidate has 20 consecutive prior hard-valid causal-coordinate sessions; candidates outside this representable domain remain under baseline admission, are audited separately, and are never labeled breakdown or non-breakdown evidence
track_b.decision_at: 15:30 Asia/Shanghai after the completed event session
track_b.action: remove only breakdown symbols from that date's new candidate list
track_b.costs_and_execution: unchanged CHINEXT V1 engine including T+1, limits, suspensions, and corporate-action semantics

track_c.mechanism: persistent stock-specific return quality per unit residual risk
track_c.score: 60-session mean residual return divided by its standard deviation

track_c.mechanism: stock-specific resilience on market-down days relative to market-up days
track_c.score: mean residual return on negative-market sessions minus mean residual return on nonnegative-market sessions

track_c.mechanism: stable rather than episodic realized risk may indicate higher-quality risk
track_c.score: negative 60-session standard deviation of rolling five-session realized volatility

track_c.mechanism: repeated absorption of negative overnight discontinuities rather than one gap event
track_c.score: fraction of negative-gap sessions closing above their open, requiring at least ten negative gaps

track_c.mechanism: persistent close-in-range strength as repeated intraday demand quality
track_c.score: 20-session mean close location within the daily high-low range
